phrases.catches: an old form said to keep working beside the current one: "still works", "is still read", "is also still accepted"
a form labelled deprecated: accepted today and refused some day, which is the state the product does not have
a form labelled legacy: older than the current one and accepted beside it
a form kept so that older input goes on working
a form said to exist only so that older input is accepted
a reader that tries the old form when the current one is absent
an old name kept as an alias of the current one

exemptions.reason: prompt_engine accepts prompt argument values in options as well as in inputs, which replaced it for that use; options also carries client_profile, which nothing else carries
exemptions.removeWhen: options is narrowed to execution hints and prompt values sent in it are refused through a ledger entry, or options is described without the word

exemptions.reason: the word names something in the user's own project, not a spelling of this product: a Keep a Changelog category, and a marker the integration gate tells the reviewer to search the change for
exemptions.removeWhen: either gate's guidance stops naming the word
